title: Three.js
summary: 3D printed like a comic rather than lit: flat colours, thick ink outlines, Ben-Day halftone dots for the shadow tone, bursts and zoom lines behind, all inside an inked panel on a paper gutter. Objects pop and boil; backdrops loop.
usage: {"piece": "three/pow-burst"}; the explainer takes words: {"piece": "three/panel-stack", "props": {"items": ["IDEA", "SCRIPT", "POST"]}}. Backdrops (speed-tunnel, city-block, dot-wave) work as a shot "background". Files: library/themes/comic/three/pieces/ (_toon.js is the shared print stage, toon material and ink helpers, not a piece).

items.name: Pow burst
items.description: Three jagged bursts stacked in depth pop out and rock in space under a star, with sparks circling over turning zoom lines.

items.name: Toon globe
items.description: A printed globe with an ink coastline and halftone night side, a tilted ring with a moon, and sparks. Loops.

items.name: Coin flip
items.description: A gold coin is flicked up, tumbles and smacks down with a burst while its hard shadow tracks it.

items.name: Rocket
items.description: A toy rocket blasting up the panel with a flickering flame, inked smoke puffs and speed streaks. Loops.

items.name: Speed tunnel
items.description: Flying down a corridor of inked panel frames in the primaries with speed streaks. Loops.

items.name: City block
items.description: A flat inked skyline with lit windows sliding past in three depths under a burst sun and a halftone sky. Loops.

items.name: Dot wave
items.description: A halftone screen seen at an angle: a floor of red and blue dots swelling as a wave rolls through. Loops.

items.name: Panel stack
items.description: Comic panels whip in one at a time and land in a fanned stack, each with a shouted word: steps, a list, a pipeline.
